questions.question: In a certain code language, "OXGP" is coded as "62" and "DSNL" is coded as "75". What is the code for "VBQT" in that language? एक विशिष्ट कोड भाषा में, "OXGP" को "62" और "DSNL" को "75" के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उस भाषा में "VBQT" का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language, "OXGP" is coded as "62" and "DSNL" is coded as "75". What is the code for "VBQT" in that language?

एक विशिष्ट कोड भाषा में, "OXGP" को "62" और "DSNL" को "75" के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उस भाषा में "VBQT" का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
Logic:
Code = (Sum of opposite letters) + (Square of number of letters)

Opposite letter formula:
Opposite value = 27 − position

Check OXGP

O (15) → 12
X (24) → 3
G (7) → 20
P (16) → 11

Sum of opposites = 12 + 3 + 20 + 11 = 46

Number of letters = 4
4² = 16

46 + 16 = 62 ✔

Check DSNL

D (4) → 23
S (19) → 8
N (14) → 13
L (12) → 15

Sum = 23 + 8 + 13 + 15 = 59

4² = 16

59 + 16 = 75 ✔

Now VBQT

V (22) → 5
B (2) → 25
Q (17) → 10
T (20) → 7

Sum = 5 + 25 + 10 + 7 = 47

4² = 16

47 + 16 = 63

Final Answer: 63 ✔

questions.question: Which of the following number will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी संख्या दी गई श्रृंखला में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर आएगी? 24, 27, 35, 59, 107, 227, ?
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following number will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी संख्या दी गई श्रृंखला में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर आएगी?

24, 27, 35, 59, 107, 227, ?
questions.solution:
Differences between terms:

27−24 = 3
35−27 = 8
59−35 = 24
107−59 = 48
227−107 = 120

These follow the pattern:

(prime)²−1

Using primes:
2²−1 = 3
3²−1 = 8
5²−1 = 24
7²−1 = 48
11²−1 = 120

Next prime = 13

13²−1 = 168

Add to 227:

227 + 168 = 395

✅ Answer: 395

questions.question: In a certain code language, DTWG is coded as 42 and RAYI is coded as 43. What is the code for OZES in that language? एक विशिष्ट कोड भाषा में, DTWG को 42 और RAYI को 43 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उस भाषा में OZES का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language, DTWG is coded as 42 and RAYI is coded as 43. What is the code for OZES in that language?

एक विशिष्ट कोड भाषा में, DTWG को 42 और RAYI को 43 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उस भाषा में OZES का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
Rule:

DTWG

Alphabet positions:

D = 4
T = 20
W = 23
G = 7

Opposite values (27 − position):

D → 23
T → 7
W → 4
G → 20

Sum:

23 + 7 + 4 + 20 = 54

Subtract 12:

54 − 12 = 42

👉 DTWG = 42

OZES

Alphabet positions:

O = 15
Z = 26
E = 5
S = 19

Opposite values:

O → 12
Z → 1
E → 22
S → 8

Sum:

12 + 1 + 22 + 8 = 43

Subtract 12:

43 − 12 = 31

👉 OZES = 31

questions.question: In a certain code language, OAVY is coded as 56 and SIXT is coded as 47. What is the code for TMZB in that language? एक विशिष्ट कोड भाषा में, OAVY को 56 और SIXT को 47 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उस भाषा में TMZB का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language, OAVY is coded as 56 and SIXT is coded as 47. What is the code for TMZB in that language?

एक विशिष्ट कोड भाषा में, OAVY को 56 और SIXT को 47 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उस भाषा में TMZB का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
Logic:
Code = (Sum of opposite alphabet values) + 11

Where opposite value = 27 − letter position

✔ OAVY → Opposite sum = 45 → 45 + 11 = 56
✔ SIXT → Opposite sum = 36 → 36 + 11 = 47
✔ TMZB → Opposite sum = 47 → 47 + 11 = 58

✅ Final Answer: 58

questions.question: Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. (NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.) (Left) 4 2 7 1 5 8 7 2 6 8 3 6 (Right) How many such prime numbers are there which are immediately followed by even numbers? नीचे दी गई संख्या श्रृंखला को देखें और उसके बाद दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दें। गिनती केवल बाएँ से दाएँ ही करनी है। (नोट: सभी संख्याएँ केवल एक अंक की हैं।) (बाएँ) 4 2 7 1 5 8 7 2 6 8 3 6 (दाएँ) ऐसी कितनी अभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं जिनके तुरंत बाद सम संख्याएँ आती हैं?
questions.questionHtml:
Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 4 2 7 1 5 8 7 2 6 8 3 6 (Right)

How many such prime numbers are there which are immediately followed by even numbers?

नीचे दी गई संख्या श्रृंखला को देखें और उसके बाद दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दें। गिनती केवल बाएँ से दाएँ ही करनी है।

(नोट: सभी संख्याएँ केवल एक अंक की हैं।)

(बाएँ) 4 2 7 1 5 8 7 2 6 8 3 6 (दाएँ)

ऐसी कितनी अभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं जिनके तुरंत बाद सम संख्याएँ आती हैं?
questions.solution:
Series:
4 2 7 1 5 8 7 2 6 8 3 6

Prime numbers (single-digit):
2, 3, 5, 7

Now check which primes are immediately followed by an even number (2, 4, 6, 8):

5 → followed by 8 ✅

7 → followed by 2 ✅

2 → followed by 6 ✅

3 → followed by 6 ✅

Total such primes = 4

✅ Final Answer: More than three (Option B)

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. ऐसी कितनी विषम संख्याएँ हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक के ठीक पहले एक पूर्ण वर्ग और ठीक बाद एक सम संख्या आती है? (ध्यान दें: 1 भी एक पूर्ण वर्ग है।)
questions.solution:
Series:

4 8 7 6 3 9 3 2 8 2 9 4 5 6 5 4 1 3 5 9 7 9 9 4 2 5 3 6 1 7 2

Perfect squares (single digit): 1, 4, 9

We need an odd number which is:
• Immediately preceded by 1 or 4 or 9
• Immediately followed by an even number

Now check carefully:

1) 9 3 2

3 is odd
Preceded by 9 ✔
Followed by 2 ✔
✔ Count = 1

2) 4 5 6

5 is odd
Preceded by 4 ✔
Followed by 6 ✔
✔ Count = 2

3) 9 9 4

Middle 9 is odd
Preceded by 9 ✔
Followed by 4 ✔
✔ Count = 3

4) 1 7 2

7 is odd
Preceded by 1 ✔
Followed by 2 ✔
✔ Count = 4

Final Count = 4

Since 4 > 3

✔ Final Answer: More than three (Option B)
